Detect penalized mean changes in one complete fish behaviour series

Source: R/fish-changepoints.R
aqt_state_changepoint.Rd

Finds global optimal piecewise-constant means under a user-declared nonnegative squared-unit penalty per additional segment and minimum sample count per segment. No hidden interpolation, time warping, statistical p-values or causal claims. This is a descriptive model. Irregular timestamps are retained but the SSE objective weights samples equally, not by duration; for irregular high-rate recordings use externally justified pre-aggregation before comparing experiments.

Usage

aqt_state_changepoint(
  data,
  outcome = "speed",
  penalty,
  min_segment = 5L,
  max_gap_s = Inf
)

Arguments

data

Data frame with a single session_id/camera_id/track_id, strictly ordered unique time_s and a finite numeric outcome.

outcome

Name of observed numeric behaviour feature, e.g. speed.

penalty

Nonnegative cost in squared outcome units per break.

min_segment

Minimum observations in every segment (>=3).

max_gap_s

Largest allowed time interval; gaps raise errors.

Value

aqt_changepoints with segment means, change-point time midpoints and a fully audited objective.
